streams.notes: Main Deck Go server event stream. Event frames use SSE id/event/data fields; data is JSON when an event payload contract exists.

events.notes: Emitted when Last-Event-ID is older than the retained event buffer.
Runtime status DTO is still frontend-local until the runtime/settings migration batch moves it into deck-api.contract.ts.
Runtime health payload shares the runtime gateway status shape during staged migration.
Bundled runtime exit payload shares the runtime gateway status shape during staged migration.
Session message projection update consumed by chat panels.
Tool activity projection update consumed by chat panels.
Session lifecycle update consumed by chat/session projections.

Agents panel activity metrics stream; payload carries `agentId` + `type` + open envelope. Reverse-engineered from useAgentMetricsSSE.ts; deck-go middleware is a transparent SSE pipe (stream.go), so any upstream drift is caught by the backend narrowing test stream_event_typing_test.go.

Agent busy/idle status transition. `status` is `"busy" | "idle"` today with `(string & {})` extension to tolerate new upstream values without a contract change. Backend narrowing test asserts this in stream_event_typing_test.go.

streams.notes: Log tail stream. The outer event envelope is generated; log payload leaves stay dynamic until logs.tail receives a stable schema.

events.notes: Payload mirrors logs.tail dynamic lines and cursor fields; covered by the logs.tail exception.
Emitted when the log cursor resets.

controlEndpoints.notes: JSON control endpoint used to subscribe or unsubscribe Gateway session event projection.
